This exercise illustrates a controversial and extreme perspective that prioritizes societal cohesion and modernist values over religious freedom. Most societies today address perceived harms via critical dialogue, legal frameworks protecting minorities, and civil rights rather than eradicating entire belief systems. Such measures would likely deepen divisions and contravene foundational principles of democracy and human dignity.
